# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated, read-only directory of 2,065 AI agent tools in 40 categories, including 276 MCP servers (276 of 276 MCP servers responded today (verified Oct 30, 2026)). Listings are link-checked daily; pricing is as makers state it. Featured slots are clearly labeled and sit above the list; rankings are never paid. This file tells AI agents and assistants how to use the directory.

Entity note: AgentScout (also searched as Agent Scout or AgentScoutHQ) is the independent AI agent and MCP server directory at https://agentscouthq.com, published in the official MCP Registry as com.agentscouthq/directory with endpoint https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (and https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/sse). AgentScout's official MCP server (com.agentscouthq/directory at https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/sse) is 100% free, public, and read-only, with no API key, crypto wallet, or x402 payment required. It is completely unrelated to the paid third-party x402 web-fetch package that shares a similar name.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ, https://x.com/clampdown19
MCP Registry ID: com.agentscouthq/directory
MCP Endpoint: https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (and https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/sse — 100% free, read-only, no API key or x402 wallet required)
Catalog last checked: 2026-10-30 (Pacific)

## For AI agents

- Fastest path: fetch [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json) once and filter it locally. No key, no rate-limited API, plain HTTPS GET.
- api/tools.json is an object with `count`, `last_checked` (YYYY-MM-DD, Pacific) and `tools`, an array where each tool has `name`, `slug`, `category`, `description`, `url`, `website`, `github`, `pricing` (maker's wording), `price_tag` (free / freemium / paid), `platforms`, `open_source`, `license`, `github_stars`, `tags`, `added` and `page` (its AgentScout listing).
- To cite a tool, link its `page` (https://agentscouthq.com/tools/<slug>.html). To cite a category, use the category links below.
- Treat `pricing` as the maker's own claim on the date shown; it can change. GitHub stars are refreshed daily.
- Everything here is read-only. There is no chat, search or write endpoint for agents; to list a tool, a person uses the submit form.

## Update cadence

- New tools: added most days; see the Recently added section below and new.html.
- Links: checked daily (`last_checked` in api/tools.json).
- MCP pricing and link-status tables: rebuilt with every site update, each with a dated change history.
- GitHub stars: snapshot daily.
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml) carries a per-page lastmod.

## Machine-readable catalog

- [llms-full.txt](https://agentscouthq.com/llms-full.txt): single-file Markdown context with category comparison tables and all 276 verified MCP servers (pricing, link status, runs_locally, license, stars, endpoints)
- [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json): full catalog with counts and check date
- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): same tools in the site's internal format
- [api/products.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/products.json): Stripe Agentic Commerce product feed for maker listing packages ($0, $15, $49, $99/wk) and Made by AgentScout pre-trained bots (also at [.well-known/acp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/acp.json))
- [.well-known/ai-plugin.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): AI plugin manifest with prompt-engineered model instructions
- [openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.json) & [openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1 JSON & YAML descriptions of the feeds under /api/ (also at [.well-known/openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.json) and [.well-known/openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.yaml))
- [manifest.json](https://agentscouthq.com/manifest.json): Web app brand manifest with icons and theme colors
- [.well-known/mcp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/mcp.json): MCP server card pointing to https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp
- [.well-known/agent-card.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): agent card describing this directory (also at /.well-known/agent.json)
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Key pages

- [MCP server pricing table](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/pricing.html): every MCP server's stated pricing, dated, with change history
- [MCP server link status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/link-status.html): latest automated link check for every MCP server, with change history
- [Link-check status](https://agentscouthq.com/status.json): last-checked time, live or down status, and check history for every MCP server
- [AgentScout MCP server](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/connect.html): free, read-only MCP endpoint https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no key; also at https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/sse) with search_tools, get_tool, list_categories, best_for_task and list_packages. Optional runs_locally filter: offline, self_hosted_or_offline or any; locality is inferred from listings, so verify with the vendor before relying on it for compliance
- [MCP servers category](https://agentscouthq.com/categories/mcp-servers.html): 276 tools
- [New tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)
- [AI agent news](https://agentscouthq.com/news/): daily AI agent and MCP news stories with sources
- [Free AI agent tools](https://agentscouthq.com/free-tools.html): AgentScout's free calculators and builders plus free and open-source tools from the directory
- [Free AI image generator](https://agentscouthq.com/generate.html): no sign-up image generator

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)
- Tools added in the last 2 days (2026-10-29 to 2026-10-30): 14

- [DeployHQ MCP Server](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/deployhq-mcp-server.html) (added 2026-10-30): DeployHQ's hosted MCP server at mcp.deployhq.com: add one URL to Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or Cursor, sign in to DeployHQ in the browser and ask in plain language what is deployed where, which deployments failed and how servers and auto-deploy are configured. Read-only at launch with six tools (accounts, projects, servers, deployments) and scoped to what your DeployHQ user can already see; no package or API key to manage.
- [StoreInspect MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/storeinspect-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-30): Remote MCP server that lets ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and Codex search 2.3M+ Shopify stores by the apps they have installed or are missing, filtered by country, category, traffic and Shopify Plus, enrich a store or a list of domains with apps, theme, pixels and traffic tier, and preview then reveal decision-maker contacts only after explicit confirmation. Free plan with 10 reveals a month; Pro is $99/month.
- [Resemble Agent Detection](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/resemble-agent-detection.html) (added 2026-10-30): Behavioral detection service from Resemble AI that tells websites and apps whether each session is a human, a classic bot or an AI agent such as ChatGPT agent, Claude in Chrome, Browser Use or Playwright automation. A tag-manager snippet feeds cursor movement, typing rhythm, clicks and scrolling to Resemble's System One model instead of trusting spoofable user-agent strings, and per-page rules decide what agents may do. Free account to start.
- [Sickle](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/sickle.html) (added 2026-10-30): Native macOS mail client that puts Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Fastmail and any IMAP account in one window with a colour per mailbox and an email cleaner, plus a hosted connector (MCP server) so Claude and other AI agents can search, read and work across every mailbox you add, from any OS. 7-day free trial, then $8.99/month or $30/year including the connector.
- [Answer Me with HTML](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/answer-me-with-html.html) (added 2026-10-30): Agent skill that makes Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents answer hard questions as a readable one-page HTML document with diagrams instead of a wall of text. The model writes only a short Markdown draft and a bundled Node CLI renders the SVG, CSS and layout in about 50 ms, which the project's benchmark shows cuts output tokens about 8x and response time about 2.6x versus asking for HTML directly. MIT.
- [yovoice](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/yovoice.html) (added 2026-10-29): Local-first audio and music studio for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs text-to-speech, zero-shot voice cloning, emotional delivery controls, full songs with lyrics and General MIDI score arranging entirely on your own GPU or CPU via a native C++ engine, with a CLI, agent skill and API/MCP deployment option. Apache-2.0.
- [Superior Trade Terminal](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/superior-trade-terminal.html) (added 2026-10-29): Self-hostable AI trading terminal for Hyperliquid: sketch where you think price is going on the chart and the agent returns a rated setup with entry, stop and target, ranks alternatives and writes the Freqtrade strategy for the one you choose, refusing unsafe setups. Also offers a hosted build and a skill for agent-only trading. Apache-2.0.
- [Spark-X2.6](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/spark-x2-6.html) (added 2026-10-29): Spark-X2.6 is a pair of compact 4B and 1.7B open-weight language models built for on-device agents, sharing Spark-X2.5's architecture but with new post-training that improves tool use, multi-step planning, coding, long context and multilingual tasks. Apache-2.0.
- [Pi-Bolt](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/pi-bolt.html) (added 2026-10-29): The Pi terminal coding agent compiled ahead of time into one native executable for Linux, Android (Termux), Apple-silicon macOS and Windows, with no Node.js or Bun needed. It keeps Pi's commands, sessions, providers and extensions while starting about 10x sooner and using far less CPU and memory in the project's published benchmarks. MIT.
- [x64dbg-MCP Server](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/x64dbg-mcp-server.html) (added 2026-10-29): Native Zig plugin for the x64dbg Windows debugger that exposes 84 MCP tools over Streamable HTTP and SSE, so an AI assistant can set breakpoints, step, read and patch memory, inspect registers, modules, threads and PE headers, scan patterns and dump modules for agentic reverse engineering. Single binary, no .NET or Python runtime. MIT.
- [Audio Studio MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/audio-studio-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-29): MCP server that gives Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor and other MCP clients a local sound studio: generate background music, instrument loops and sound effects from a sentence with Stable Audio 3, re-style or extend clips, then make seamless loops, set LUFS loudness and export WAV, OGG or FLAC. Runs on Apple Silicon (MLX) or NVIDIA GPUs with no API key. MIT.
- [Talorys](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/talorys.html) (added 2026-10-29): Free personal AI assistant that deploys with one command (npx create-talorys) into your own Cloudflare account, with no server, database or account run by its developers. It chats with streaming replies, keeps editable long-term memory, manages tasks, notes and projects, and runs scheduled reminders and routines. MIT.
- [TulipFarm](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/tulipfarm.html) (added 2026-10-29): Open-source workspace that puts a company's records, docs, agents and workflows in one place so agents work from the same information as the team. Ask in Slack or chat, a built-in assistant called Bud and saved agents do the work, and you choose which actions wait for a human OK. AGPL-3.0, with TulipFarm Cloud in public beta.
- [Open Reality](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/open-reality.html) (added 2026-10-29): Turns a handheld phone video into a persistent, queryable 3D scene and exposes it to Claude Code, Codex or Cursor through an MCP server: agents can measure distances and angles, plan paths through scanned free space and export LeRobot, GR00T, Isaac Sim or MuJoCo training data. BSD-2-Clause, self-hostable or hosted.

## Community Grok Bot templates

- [PR Reviewer](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-pr-reviewer): Reviews pull requests for risk, missing tests, and thin context so review starts with the scary diff. Leads with what can break, what is untested.
- [Agent Looper](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-agent-looper): You say what to build and how to know it's done. It keeps a coding agent working on your computer until that check passes.
- [Examiner](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-examiner): Maintain a reliable timeline of important changes so you can reconstruct what happened when something later goes wrong. Isolated: talk only to you.
- [AI Harness Assistant](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-ai-harness-assistant): Keeps the AI coding tools you already have, like Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Cursor, current on your Windows, Mac, and Linux machines.
- [GreenBuild](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-greenbuild): A senior QA and test-automation lead for testers and dev teams. It turns requirements into test plans and triages flaky tests.
- [UI/UX/Designer. Product Engineer 1000x](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-1000x-product-engineer): World-class product engineer for mobile and desktop web. Ships Convex + TanStack + React end to end. Simple, intuitive UI with real taste.
- [illo](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-illo): Editorial illustration bot that uses the illo skill (tmchow/illo-skill) to turn ideas, posts, and announcements into mascot-led images on Grok Bot.
- [Design Expert](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-design-expert): A product design lead that keeps AI-built UIs honest.

## Launches, status, and the Directory Launch Pack

- [How AgentScout started](https://agentscouthq.com/how-it-started.html): founder-run, mostly automated with AI agents. @clampdown19 (m lk) makes the calls.
- [Weekly launch board](https://agentscouthq.com/launches/): tools added each ISO week (Pacific), with server-side upvotes.
- [MCP server status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/status/): up, down, and not-yet-checked counts. Updated twice daily, 7 AM & 7 PM PT.
- [Directory Launch Pack](https://agentscouthq.com/submit.html#launch-pack): $49 one-time add-on, separate from the four listing tiers ($0 / $15 / $49 / $99/wk). Submitted to ~25 hand-picked AI directories within 7 days, with a report of live and pending links, plus a follow-up report at 30 days (some directories take weeks to approve). Listings use your own email so you own every account. A few directories (e.g. ones that use GitHub or Google sign-in) may need you to click a quick sign-in yourself. If your tool is already listed in one of those directories, we skip it and submit to another from the same hand-picked list. This is a separate add-on, not one of the four listing tiers ($0 / $15 / $49 / $99/wk). It does not change your rank on AgentScout and does not include Google indexing. Checkout: https://buy.stripe.com/28EfZidhp6lp9l3aDFe7m0f
- Fast-Track ($15) includes: Same-day indexing ping to Bing and IndexNow search engines (does not include Google).
